headline_marked: Over 50 injured as [[Chhatra Dal and Shibir clash]] at 3 Dhaka campuses
headline: Over 50 injured as Chhatra Dal and Shibir clash at 3 Dhaka campuses
summary: Violence erupted at Jagannath University, Dhaka College, and Govt Madrasa-e-Alia, marking the largest clash between the two student wings since the July uprising.
details: Violence broke out on Tuesday between activists of Chhatra Dal and Islami Chhatra Shibir across three educational institutions in Dhaka: Jagannath University (JnU), Dhaka College, and Government Madrasa-e-Alia.
Over 50 activists were injured in the clashes, with many suffering head injuries. Several critically injured individuals were transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.

The conflict at Jagannath University began around 12 PM during a documentary screening. Tensions rose when activists from JNUS, Chhatra Shakti, and Inkilab Manch attempted to enter the hall with placards, but were blocked by Chhatra Dal.

Witnesses report that the clash escalated after Chhatra Dal activists attacked a Shibir leader. The violence spread to the university's medical center and even extended to the Dhaka National Medical Institute Hospital, where injured Shibir activists were attacked twice more.
This follows a similar clash between the two groups at Begum Rokeya University in Rangpur on Monday, making it four campuses hit by violence in two days.

The tension stems from recent student union elections where Shibir-backed panels won most seats in five major universities, while Chhatra Dal performed poorly. Chhatra Dal alleges that Shibir had organized themselves while remaining hidden during the previous government's tenure.

headline_marked: 6 [[Naya Dhara leaders taken into custody]] after Press Club clash
headline: 6 Naya Dhara leaders taken into custody after Press Club clash
summary: The leaders were detained following a violent confrontation with the Rashtra Sanglap Forum and a subsequent three-hour standoff at Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
details: Police took six leaders and activists of Naya Dhara Bangladesh into custody on Tuesday night. This followed a clash with members of the Rashtra Sanglap Forum near the Jatiya Press Club and a tense three-hour standoff at Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).

The detained individuals include Naya Dhara Chairman Momin Mehedi, Senior Vice-Chairman Shanta Farzana, and Vice-Chairman Dr Nurjahan Nira, along with three other senior officials. They were escorted from the hospital's emergency department under police protection around 11:10 pm.

The conflict began Tuesday evening during a Naya Dhara program protesting an alleged assault on Shanta Farzana. The clash left several people from both sides injured, including Shanta and Rashtra Sanglap Forum Member Secretary ANM Ayas, who were taken to DMCH for treatment.

Tensions escalated at the hospital when supporters of the Rashtra Sanglap Forum allegedly confined Naya Dhara leaders inside the emergency department for three hours. Reports indicate they were attacked again while police were escorting them out.

The unrest caused significant disorder inside the emergency department, disrupting medical services for approximately one and a half hours. Police officials stated that the situation created fear among patients and their attendants.

Both organizations provided conflicting accounts of the incident. Rashtra Sanglap Forum alleged that Naya Dhara activists attacked them after protests over offensive remarks, while Naya Dhara claimed the Rashtra Sanglap Forum initiated the attack and stole journalists' phones.
